text:
mira: quick sync: proposing left-panel regroup into 3 zones (Workspaces / Model registry / Insights). Aim: fewer clicks, clearer deep-links. tiny route contract below.

mira: canonical examples: /app/ws/:wsId, /app/ws/:wsId/registry/:modelId, /app/ws/:wsId/insights/requests?range=30d

jon: engineering: +1 path-based routing only. Hashes break history and sharing. We'll migrate to react-router paths.

priya: PM: agree. Need redirect plan for old bookmarks. Server-side redirects + banner for 6 months.

sam: a11y: each zone must be a nav landmark (aria-label), breadcrumb last item aria-current="page"; add tab stops between zones.

lee: UX: show compact breadcrumb visually as "Workspace > Model" (omit intermediate label) but keep full path in URL. Also truncate middle crumbs on small screens.

mira: action items: mira mockups (Thu), jon prototype + shim (start tomorrow), sam a11y checklist (next Tue), priya customer comms (Mon).

deploy-bot: preview-deploy: staging/ia-leftpanel available at https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/ia-leftpanel :rocket:

jon: I'll open an RFC PR and post staging link when ready.
